[[Lord/Legends|Lord]] '''Krall''' was an individual whose existence predated the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="Onslaught" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Krall was mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'' expansion within the description of the general Tactical item "Krall's Accord", which is awarded to players at the end of the ''Onslaught'' storyline.<ref name="Onslaught" />
